grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are a party to the divorce or dissolution proceedings before processing the consent order application

grants.description: Check your divorce or civil partnership dissolution status with the court
grants.purpose: To verify you have reached conditional order stage and are eligible to apply for a consent order

grants.description: Share financial information and draft consent order details
grants.purpose: For the judge to review the proposed financial division and determine if it is fair

grants.description: Provide statement of information form detailing your financial circumstances
grants.purpose: To give the court full context about both parties' financial situations when reviewing the consent order

grants.description: Provide your address and contact information for correspondence
grants.purpose: For the court to send you the approved consent order and any correspondence about your application

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMCTS Financial Remedy or withdraw application through your case portal
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before judicial approval. Once approved, the consent order becomes legally binding and can only be changed by applying to vary the order.

delegation.limitations: Agent CANNOT sign the consent order on behalf of either party - both parties must sign personally. Agent CANNOT draft the consent order - this must be prepared by a solicitor or legal adviser. Agent CANNOT make payment without explicit authorization. Agent CANNOT agree to financial terms on your behalf. Agent can only help with form completion and submission.
